title: Bridging the Knowledge-Prediction Gap in LLMs on Multiple-Choice Questions
findings: A notable 'knowledge-prediction gap' was observed on the BBQ-Religion bias benchmark, where models' internal representations often contain the correct answer even when the final output is wrong. This gap is particularly pronounced in truthfulness and bias tasks compared to knowledge-intensive tasks. The proposed intervention method, KAPPA, successfully reduces this gap, leading to improved accuracy and better alignment between the models' internal knowledge and their predictions on religious bias questions.
